chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Mahziyar who said:

I wrote to him, 'A man performs Hajj on behalf of the Nasibi (Hostile one), would there be a sin upon him when he performs Hajj on behalf of the Nasibi, and would that be beneficial to the Nasibi or not?' So he wrote: 'Do not perform Hajj on behalf of the Nasibi, nor perform Hajj with him'.

key_terms.النَّاصِبِ: Nasibi (Hostile one, specifically one hostile to the Ahl al-Bayt)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on performing Hajj on behalf of a Nasibi?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, the Imam clarifies the fiqh of Hajj performed on behalf of a *Nasibi* (adversary of the Ahl al-Bayt), addressing both the sin incurred by the performer and the spiritual benefit for the represented individual. The ruling distinguishes between performing Hajj *for* them (on their behalf) and performing it *with* them (accompanying them), ultimately advising against both to ensure the purity of the act and the individual. This reflects the Shia emphasis on the theological status of the *Nasibi* affecting the validity and acceptance of their religious duties.
